name: a6fdvd-u3-floating-button
goal: U3 Floating agent button never covers content or controls (specification/designs/full-pass/README.md section U3): hide the floating bubble while the design conversation (ThreadPanel) or the project agent panel is open; main reserves bottom padding of bubble height + 16px. Scope: packages/reports FloatingChat.svelte + floating-chat CSS, packages/desktop WorkspaceShell/EntityView wiring and main padding, and its rendered Playwright test ui-floating-agent.spec.ts.

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
Run harness loop siblings to record the root cause and evaluate the same pattern across committed source.
Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
